definition.first_agreement: For one prompt asked of one engine in one mode on one night, over the answers that succeeded and whose tools the judge listed: 1.0 when every such answer names the same tool first, 0.5 when two of three do, 0.0 otherwise; not defined with fewer than two such answers or when none of them names a tool.
definition.set_agreement: For the same cell and the same answers, the average overlap (Jaccard index) between the sets of tools each pair of answers names; 1.0 means identical sets and 0.0 means nothing in common; not defined with fewer than two such answers.
